views.name: store_order_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    store_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders
GROUP BY store_id
views.description: aggregates order records per store, yielding total order count and delivered order count

views.name: top_store_ratio
views.body_sql:
SELECT s.store_id, s.delivered_orders * 1.0 / s.total_orders AS delivered_to_total_ratio
FROM store_order_counts s
views.description: ranks stores by total order count, computes the delivered-to-total ratio, and filters to the highest-ranked store
